summary: US and Israel are planning a wide-scale bombing campaign against Iran's energy infrastructure, potentially as early as this weekend. Iran has struck multiple energy installations across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Israel, while Russia is providing Iran with satellite surveillance and signals intelligence. The IDF has continued targeted killings of Hamas commanders in Gaza amid ongoing tensions in southern Lebanon and the West Bank.
key_points: US and Israel planning bombing of Iran energy infrastructure this weekend per CBS News (Source: @mamlekate/104052).
Iran struck Ghawar, Abqaiq, Khurais in Saudi Arabia and Ruwais, Zakum in UAE among other energy targets (Source: @kianmeli1/90410).
IDF killed Hamas deputy cell commander Kardi in Gaza City airstrike; he held hostages Romi Gonen and Noa Marciano (Source: @idf_telegram/24799).
Russia providing Iran satellite surveillance and signals intelligence to locate US forces and jam American weapons (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5974).
Iranian forces attacked oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz, causing engine room damage and loss of control (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382336).
Saudi Arabia reportedly planning heavy military offensive against Iran-backed Houthi militias in Yemen (Source: @kianmeli1/90396).
14 Golani Brigade soldiers sentenced to 30 days imprisonment for disciplinary violation; ~80 others to undergo process (Source: @inon_yttach/9772).

sections.executive_summary: US and Israel are planning a wide-scale bombing campaign against Iran's energy infrastructure, potentially as early as this weekend. Iran has struck multiple energy installations across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Israel, while Russia is providing Iran with satellite surveillance and signals intelligence. The IDF has continued targeted killings of Hamas commanders in Gaza amid ongoing tensions in southern Lebanon and the West Bank.
iran: Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian parliament, stated that on the first day of the war (9th of Farvardin), they learned of their leader's death one hour after bombing. They gathered leaders by 8pm and decided to announce the death the next morning (Source: @VahidOnline/77693).

CBS News reports US and Israel are planning one of the most intense bombing campaigns to date against Iran's energy-related infrastructure, possibly Saturday or Sunday (10-11 Mordad) (Source: @mamlekate/104052).

Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary warned that continued maritime blockade and war by the US system will lead to tightening the blockade on the Strait of Hormuz and closing other straits (Source: @naya_foriraq/86588).

Russia is providing Iran with satellite surveillance and signals intelligence that may help Tehran locate US forces, improve air defenses, and jam American-made weapons per US and European officials (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5974).
IRGC Navy issued warnings to vessels attempting unauthorized passage through the Strait of Hormuz, prompting several tankers to alter course and turn back (Source: @presstv/201111).
An explosion was heard near the Pardis road toward Tehran around 2am; no explosion was heard during the day on the Pardis road (Source: @mamlekate/104046).

Iranian state media faces public criticism over monopolizing narratives; citizens turn to foreign media and cyberspace for alternative reporting, eroding trust in official state broadcasting (Source: @SharghDaily/175546).
israel: IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas deputy cell commander Abd al-Rahim Abd al-Hay Youssef Kardi in Gaza City airstrike; he held hostages Romi Gonen and Cpl. Noa Marciano and served as a doctor at Shifa Hospital (Source: @idf_telegram/24799).

IDF killed Hamas commander Ahmad Hussein Mohammad Kafina, commander of the central camps sector, in a precise airstrike in southern Gaza Strip; he directed the October 7 massacre and kidnapping of Abinadav Or and Noa Argamani (Source: @New_security8200/203113).

Israeli citizens entered the outskirts of Nablus in the Samaria region; Palestinians threw stones at them, an Israeli citizen fired into the air with no casualties, and some Israeli citizens vandalized a cemetery (Source: @yediotnews25/133458).

IDF spokesperson stated that any agreement will be tested solely by whether it achieves the war's goals: destroying Hamas's military-political power or dismantling it; anything less is total failure (Source: @yediotnews25/133465).

14 Golani Brigade soldiers who led a disciplinary incident were sentenced to 30 days imprisonment, dismissed from combat, and transferred from active service; approximately 80 additional soldiers will undergo a command educational process (Source: @inon_yttach/9772).
Trump stated that no one thought it would be possible to disarm Hamas (Source: @asafroz/52137).
Israeli Channel 14 reported that a significant event is imminent (Source: @kianmeli1/90399).
gaza_west_bank: IDF killed Hamas deputy cell commander Kardi in Gaza City airstrike; he was involved in holding hostage Romi Gonen at Shifa Hospital and the body of Noa Marciano after her murder (Source: @idf_telegram/24799).

IDF killed Hamas central camps sector commander Kafina in southern Gaza airstrike; he directed the October 7 attack and kidnapping of Abinadav Or, Noa Argamani, and Sodaisak Rintalak (Source: @New_security8200/203113).

Israeli citizens entered the outskirts of Nablus in the Samaria region of the West Bank; Palestinians threw stones and an Israeli citizen fired into the air with no injuries reported (Source: @yediotnews25/133458).

IDF forces deployed in the Nablus area dispersed the gathering and removed all Israeli citizens from the area; forces remained deployed across the sector to prevent further friction (Source: @yediotnews25/133458).
IDF spokesperson emphasized that entry into Area A is forbidden and dangerous for Israelis and constitutes a violation of the law (Source: @yediotnews25/133458).
lebanon: A large explosion was reported between the towns of Hadatha and Beit Yahuun, attributed to the enemy army (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382330).
Artillery shelling was reported in Lebanon, attributed to Ali al-Tahir, with a live map provided for further details (Source: @redlinkleb/34139).
Reports of artillery fire in southern Lebanon; a Merkava tank of the IDF fired volleys toward the nearby town of Tlosha (Source: @yediotnews25/133459).
Strict censorship is in place regarding a security event involving the army; no one knows the details of the news (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382325).
syria_iraq: A security event occurred involving the army with strict censorship; no details are known about the incident (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382327).
Limited specific information available regarding Syria or Iraq operations in the provided messages.
gulf_states: Iranian forces attacked another oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz last night; a projectile struck the engine room causing loss of vessel control (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382336).
The British Maritime Trade Operations centre updated that a ship was attacked in the southern route near Oman in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @asafroz/52171).
UKMTO issued Warning 101-26 regarding maritime security threats in the region (Source: @shin_persian/8761).
Hostile drone attacks were intercepted in Kuwait at 0624Z (Source: @shin_persian/8762).
Saudi Arabia is planning a heavy and aggressive military offensive against Iran-backed Houthi militias in Yemen under Trump's decisive doctrine (Source: @kianmeli1/90396).

A US Nimitz-class aircraft carrier (USS Abraham Lincoln or USS George H.W. Bush) was sailing south in the Arabian Sea approximately 40 nautical miles east of Oman, escorted by a single destroyer (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5966).

Iran attacked energy targets including Ghawar, Abqaiq, and Khurais in Saudi Arabia; Ruwais and Zakum in UAE; North Gas Field and Ras Laffan LNG in Qatar; Burgan in Kuwait; Stella and Al-Amaya in Bahrain; Leviathan and Tamar in Israel (Source: @kianmeli1/90410).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level across the Middle East is sharply elevated. The reported US-Israeli planning to strike Iran's energy infrastructure represents a significant escalation that Iran has already warned will trigger a broad response targeting critical infrastructure in Israel and US energy assets in the region. Iran's simultaneous attacks on energy installations in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain demonstrate operational reach across multiple Gulf states. The Strait of Hormuz remains a flashpoint with Iranian naval warnings to commercial vessels and attacks on tankers, while Russia's provision of satellite intelligence to Iran enhances Tehran's ability to target US forces and jam American weapons systems.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are mobilizing across multiple fronts. Saudi Arabia is reportedly preparing a heavy ground offensive against Houthi militias in Yemen, while the US has deployed a Nimitz-class carrier approximately 40 nautical miles east of Oman in the Arabian Sea. Kuwait has intercepted hostile drone attacks, and the UKMTO has issued maritime security warnings. Israel maintains forces in southern Gaza and the West Bank, with the IDF conducting targeted killings of Hamas commanders and managing friction at Nablus. Iran's Supreme National Security Council has warned that continued US maritime blockade will lead to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and other waterways.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian leadership reportedly learned of the Supreme Leader's death during the first day of the war but was ordered to deny it until dawn, indicating potential command-and-control disruptions. The IDF's Golani Brigade disciplinary incident involving 14 soldiers sentenced to imprisonment and ~80 others suggests internal cohesion challenges within elite units. Iran's state media is losing public trust as citizens turn to foreign outlets, which may affect domestic morale and war sustainability. Multiple sources indicate Iran has prepared a broad response plan targeting Israeli and US energy infrastructure in retaliation for planned strikes.
